meta.title: implement context caching
meta.body_summary: Implement cached content resource and data handling for the Gemini PHP client, adding create/retrieve/list/update/delete operations with tests and fixtures.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added full context caching feature with tests but PR closed without maintainer review; no performance evidence beyond narrative.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1603 changed lines across 25 files, this is a medium-to-large feature addition by absolute volume, though much churn is from repeated addition/removal of CI workflow files. As a performance-oriented feature PR, it was closed without merge, likely due to lack of maintainer review engagement.

review_details.concern_detail: The PR received no formal reviews or maintainer comments; closed without feedback.
review_details.performance_claim: Add context caching to reduce API latency by reusing cached contexts.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed without any maintainer review or merge; no explicit rejection reason available.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent delivered a complete feature with tests, but the PR remained unmerged due to lack of maintainer engagement, illustrating a process boundary where agent contributions are useless without human buy-in.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiling data; author provided a test script link but not performance analysis.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no regression handling as it was never incorporated.

core_change_summary.description: Added CachedContent resource, request/response classes, and client methods for create, retrieve, list, update, delete operations on cached contexts. Included tests, test fixtures, and updated client interface/contract.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Workflow files were added and later removed; they contributed to churn but not to the caching feature itself.
change_trajectory: Initial commit added all caching-related source files and tests.
Subsequent commits fixed validation, request handling, and merged code review fixes from a side branch.
Later commits added and later removed Claude workflow configurations and made minor type fixes.

review_signals.summary: Author provided a link to a test script for manual verification.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with full implementation and tests.
Author posted one comment with a test script link.
No maintainer interaction recorded; multiple commits by author with clean-up.
